March 30, 2020 Uncategorized 997

Dear patients,

These are unprecedented times and Kevin has made the very difficult decision to close the practice until further notice.

Theale Dental Surgery has strict cross-infection control and hygiene protocol, which have been enhanced following Government advice, NHS and British Dental Association guidelines.

We not only have a duty of care to our patients, our staff and their families, but to everyone to help reduce the spread of COVID 19.

STAY HOME. SAVE THE NHS. SAVE LIVES.

If you are experiencing acute pain, please call the practice on 0118 9303387 or email [email protected] , where we be able to offer advice or prescribe antibiotics if necessary.

We will keep you updated throughout this and will resume normal working hours as soon as possible.

We are here for you and we will all get through this together.

Stay safe and well.

Kevin, Laura and the team at Theale Dental Surgery.
